citation: de Jong et al. 2015 (PBE); Pandit & Bongiorno 2023 (Ag PBE); Wang & Li 2008 (Au PW91); Liu et al. 2024 (r2SCAN bulk shift)
description: 0K PBE/published-DFT elastic constants for 15 cubic metals. Ag from Pandit & Bongiorno 2023 (PBE); Au from Wang & Li 2008 (PW91-GGA fallback). r2SCAN values approximated by scalar bulk-modulus shift from Liu et al. 2024 where available.

Ag.r2scan_source: Liu et al. 2024 bulk-modulus scaling (B_r2SCAN=104.4 GPa / B_PBE=88.33 GPa)
Ag.source: Pandit, A. & Bongiorno, A. "A first-principles method to calculate fourth-order elastic constants of solid materials." arXiv:2302.01965 (2023); PBE, Quantum ESPRESSO, 25x25x25 k-points.

Al.r2scan_source: No r2SCAN bulk modulus in Liu et al. 2024; unshifted PBE baseline retained.
Al.source: de Jong et al., Scientific Data 2, 150009 (2015); PBE/GGA, VASP, stress-strain method (Le Page & Saxe 2002), 0 K

Au.functional_note: PW91-GGA, not PBE. Used because no stable published PBE tensor for fcc Au was found.
Au.r2scan_source: Liu et al. 2024 bulk-modulus scaling (B_r2SCAN=153.5 GPa / B_PBE=150.10 GPa)
Au.source: Wang, G. & Li, X. "Predicting the Young's modulus of nanowires from first-principles calculations on their surface and bulk materials." J. Appl. Phys. 104, 113511 (2008); VASP/PW91-GGA.

methodology: PBE tensors from de Jong 2015 matminer elastic_tensor_2015. Ag tensor from Pandit & Bongiorno 2023 PBE. Au tensor from Wang & Li 2008 PW91 because MP-API PBE tensor is unphysical. r2SCAN tensors approximated by Cij_r2SCAN = Cij_PBE * (B_r2SCAN/B_PBE) using Liu et al. 2024 bulk moduli.
